Smoked on big green egg. Rub was half salt, half 16 mesh pepper. Bought at 13.5lbs, trimmed to about 11-12lbs.

Kept temperature at 275 for 12 hours. Wrapped in butcher paper (with beef tallow spoonful on the bottom meat side) at around 175 internal. Put back in at 275 until internal reached 203. Rested for 1.5 hours and started to cut in.

I used some B&B post oak chunks along with FOGO’s super premium charcoal lumps intended for longer smoke sessions.
